title: Synergistic energy harvesting and catalysis in B2SSe–MSSe (M = Mo, W) van der Waals heterostructures
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,836-848
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07674A, Paper

Basit Ali, Khadija Bashir, Yuanping Chen, Sailing He, M. Idrees, B. Amin
In this study, we employed density functional theory (DFT) to investigate the structural, electronic, optical and photocatalytic properties of B2SSe–MSSe (M = Mo, W) van der Waals heterostructures (vdWHs).
